decisions.reason: The service is increasingly commoditised by collaboration platforms, but it still complements managed voice and remains worth keeping under review.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to our strategy and has proven adoption, so we will keep it with a very low withdrawal risk.
The portal enhances digital self-service and operational efficiency, aligning with our automation goals, so we keep it.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy circuit-switched service in structural decline and misaligned with our all-IP, software-defined direction, so we will drop it.
Direct voice network connection supports enterprise voice migration and complements our managed network portfolio, so we keep it.
